The '''BXT-4 central processing computer''' was model of [[Computer/Legends|computer]] manufactured by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]]. It was installed in Arakyd's [[Mark VII "Inquisitor" Series Seeker Droid]] where it operated in conjunction with an [[AA-1 VerboBrain/Legends|AA-1 VerboBrain]].<ref name="EGWT" />
